auto_detection_scope: Conservative lyrics-based Turkish/Kurmanji selection; other languages require a separately validated model.
safeguards: Retain supplied text and manual/locked words
Do not lower existing CTC acceptance or review thresholds
Only replace measured weak intervals with corroborated high-confidence candidates
Require distinct audio channels for boundary confirmation
Compare recovered repetitions against both matching and different words
Never substitute a presumed vowel pronunciation for the supplied letter
limitations: A timestamp is not a guarantee of correct alignment
Kurdish support currently means Latin-script Kurmanji, not every Kurdish dialect or script
A confident model trained for read speech can still misalign singing
The MMS model used for Kurmanji and optional Turkish crosschecking has a noncommercial model license; see its model card

repeat_estimation.trigger: Only an explicit supplied-lyrics synchronization request
repeat_estimation.reference_scope: Measured words in the same recording only
priority: Robust same-word measured duration, positioned only within the target recording interval
repeat_estimation.label: Tahmini
repeat_estimation.fading_tail: Borrow measured word lengths only; centre them on the target tail's own weak CTC intervals, never donor offsets or gaps
repeat_estimation.position: Only the target word current interval, local vocal energy and neighbouring boundaries; donor positions and tempo scales are not copied

dual_audio_crosscheck.trigger: Explicit supplied-lyrics alignment; pending Turkish or Latin-script Kurmanji words after multilingual merging
dual_audio_crosscheck.source_mapping: Exact stem membership in saved separation provenance; ambiguous or different-duration recordings are skipped
dual_audio_crosscheck.unavailable_optional_models: Keep warnings and original timings; report the failure without aborting the completed base alignment

generated_music_suffix_guard.scope: Unlocked automatic repeat rows only; supplied and manual lyric rows remain unchanged
generated_music_suffix_guard.trigger: Uncertain trailing words after a gap of at least three seconds, inside independently verified accompaniment without voice
generated_music_suffix_guard.confirmation: Longest audible supplied prefix with every word at least 0.5 on both original and vocal recording, boundaries within 0.16 seconds
generated_music_suffix_guard.archive: Preserve the full generated row in repeat_cleanup before shortening the repeat
generated_music_suffix_guard.mms_voice_veto: Character emissions alone cannot veto an independently detected instrumental break

score_handling.missing_null_nonfinite_invalid: No usable acoustic evidence; never treat as confirmation or abort the remaining song
